m: एज् cl. 1. P. एजति, to stir, move, tremble, shake, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; BhP. : cl. 1. Ā. एजते, एजां-चक्रे, एजिता, to shine, Dhātup. vi, 20 : Caus. P. Ā. एजयति, -ते, to agitate, shake, ŚBr.; BhP.
a: एज् — I. {c1c} A. (epic. P.) (एजते; एजांचक्रे, ऐजिष्ट, एजितुं, एजित) 1 To tremble, shake. --2 To move, stir; धृतराष्ट्रोयमेजति Mb. --3 To shine (P.). --WITH अप to drive away. --उद् to rise, go upwards.

m: एजथु m. trembling, motion, shaking (of the earth), AV. xii, 1, 18.
a: एजथुः — m. Ved. Trembling, shaking (of the earth).

m: एजत् mfn. (pres. p. of the above)
एजत् (त्), n. anything moving or living, RV.; AV.
एजत्क mfn. trembling, moving (the head), BhP. ix, 6, 42
एजत्क (अस्), m. a kind of insect, AV. v, 23, 7.

v: tri॰ eja--Ric--KaS । kampake janamajayaH anaNgamejayaH arimejayaH viSvamejayaH ।
m: एजय mfn. causing to shake or tremble (forming irr. compounds with preceding acc. Pāṇ. iii, 2, 28; cf. जनम्-एजय).

v: tri॰ eja--in । vAtarogagraste tatI'patye kurvA॰ Rya । Ejya tadapatye puMstrI ।
m: एजि m. N. of a man g. कुर्व्-आदि, Pāṇ. iv, 1, 151 (not in Kāś.)
एजितृ mfn. a shaker, causing to tremble.

v: tri॰ A + yaja--karmmaRi kyup । samyagyajanIye “AyajatAmejyA iza iti prajAyA izastA evEtadyAyajUkAH” Sata॰ brA॰ 17, 3, 15 ।
m: एज्य mf(आ)n. (irr. fut. pass. p. fr. आ-√ यज्) to be offered (as an oblation), ŚBr. i, 7, 3, 14.
